title: Blood Orange Sorbet Recipe
ldIngredientsRaw: 3 cups (700ml) freshly squeezed blood orange juice  ((or regular orange juice))
ldInstructionsRaw: In a small nonreactive saucepan mix 1 cup (250ml) juice with sugar.
Stir over low heat until the sugar is dissolved.
Scrape the dissolved sugar and orange juice into the remaining 2 cups of blood orange juice.
Chill thoroughly, then freeze in your ice cream maker according to the manufacturer's directions.
